naslov: Liquid AI LFM3: six small open models that run on a phone
opis:
Liquid AI released LFM3, a family of six models of around 2 billion parameters, all built on the same base: the LFM3-1.7B text model, LFM3-VL-2B for images and video, an audio model, an "omni" model and two decision models.

Why it matters: This is a realistic candidate for AI inside an iOS or web app, with no server and no per-call fees.

opis:

Why it matters: For now this is a research preview for a small group of testers.

naslov: Try NVIDIA SkillSpector: A scanner that checks skills for Claude Code, Codex and MCP before…
opis:
A scanner that checks skills for Claude Code, Codex and MCP before you install them, looking for prompt injection (hidden instructions for the AI), data leaks…

How to try it:
1. Install: uv tool install git+https://github.com/NVIDIA/skillspector.git (needs Python 3.12+).
2. Quick check without an LLM: skillspector scan ./path-to-skill/ --no-llm
3. For deeper analysis via Claude: export SKILLSPECTOR_PROVIDER=anthropic and set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, then run without --no-llm.
4. For a report file: --format json --output report.json

Price: free (Apache 2.0); LLM analysis uses your provider's tokens

Official link: https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillSpector

naslov: AI app idea: A skill guard for CI – Claude Code skills get installed on trust and can contain…
opis:
A skill guard for CI: Claude Code skills get installed on trust and can contain hidden instructions or send data out.

Who it is for: Developers and small teams who share .claude/skills in a repo

How AI helps: SkillSpector statically checks every new skill, and optionally Claude analyzes it further and explains the risk in a PR comment.

First steps:
1. Build a GitHub Action that installs SkillSpector via uv.
2. Run skillspector scan --no-llm --format json on every PR that changes .claude/skills.
3. Parse the JSON and leave a short comment on the PR, and block the merge when the risk is high.
4. Publish the Action on the GitHub Marketplace.

Difficulty: 2/5 · weekend project
